title: Life threatening bleeding pressure routine
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for direct pressure, clean covering, and urgent escalation for severe bleeding.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: spurting blood, soaking cloths, amputation, deep wound, dizziness, or shock signs.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: spurting blood, soaking cloths, amputation, deep wound, dizziness, or shock signs

title: Shock warmth and monitoring routine
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for keeping a seriously injured person still, warm, reassured, and observed.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: pale clammy skin, fast weak pulse, confusion, fainting, severe thirst, or heavy bleeding.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: pale clammy skin, fast weak pulse, confusion, fainting, severe thirst, or heavy bleeding

title: Head injury observation log
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for recording time, symptoms, and worsening signs after a blow to the head.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: loss of consciousness, repeated vomiting, unequal pupils, seizure, confusion, or blood from ear or nose.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: loss of consciousness, repeated vomiting, unequal pupils, seizure, confusion, or blood from ear or nose

title: Neck and spine movement boundary
category: Medical and first · Aid · Disaster · Health
summary: Medical-heavy survival entry for avoiding unnecessary movement after falls, crashes, crushes, or head injuries.
warnings: Escalate urgently if you see: numbness, weakness, neck pain, back pain, confusion, high fall, or vehicle impact.
failure_signs: Red flags appear: numbness, weakness, neck pain, back pain, confusion, high fall, or vehicle impact
